experiment: Actual Chromium browser review over local OIDC, Temporal and approved RAG publication
identities: Generated local fixture accounts; all browser actions are automated, not owner human review.
limitations: This run checks the actual browser and local services, not production identity or accessibility certification.
PDF page-count headers are checked here; Python integration tests independently parse the returned single-page PDFs.
No neural answer-quality or human reading/comprehension claim is made.

checks.name: Reader-scoped reviewer sees one native page, cannot inspect OCR or decide an unreadable batch
HttpOnly opaque session; no tokens in session JSON, JavaScript cookies or browser storage
Logout clears protected UI and invalidates the previous server session
Analyst reviewer sees actual PDFium PNG page pixels, native/OCR PDF bytes, source hashes and exact chunk spans
A mutation without the session CSRF token is refused
Approval through the actual UI produces a durable receipt and a separate completed publication
Rejection through the actual UI records a terminal rejection without authorizing publication
Audit UI distinguishes an accepted decision from an observed publication and verifies the local chain
Beta reviewer sees and approves only the Beta queue; direct Alpha review access is denied
Review desk remains within a 390-pixel viewport
